anomalies.description: Multi-Developer Transition from DB Realty to Rustomjee Group: Project was originally conceived by DB Realty as 'DB Crown' and subsequently acquired and completed by Real Gem Buildtech Pvt. Ltd. under the Rustomjee Group ('Rustomjee Crown').
anomalies.significance: Explains why municipal files trace back to 2009 under DB Realty while final approvals, RERA disclosures, and Occupancy Certificates are branded Rustomjee Crown.

anomalies.description: Separate Occupancy Certificate Milestones between Wings: While Wing A received early OCC up to 62nd floor in August 2023, Wing B received its Part OCC for floors 14 to 62 in March 2024 (EB/5070/GS/A/OCC/2/New) and its final 63rd floor Full OCC in September 2024 (EB/5070/GS/A/OCC/3/New).
anomalies.significance: Establishes independent occupancy and statutory completion timelines for Wing B.

anomalies.description: Cross-Referenced Unified RERA Project Inventory: Statutory disclosures for Wing B were filed as part of the integrated Rustomjee Crown Phase I schedule (P51900003268) comprising 186 units for Wing A (Sr 1-186) and 186 units for Wing B (Sr 187-372), verified against Chartered Accountant Form 3 Annexure A.
anomalies.significance: Provides mathematical reconciliation for the complete 372-unit residential master scheme.

anomalies.description: Multi-Source Extraction vs. Layout OCR Model Synthesis: Synthesis of 37-document statutory portfolio data (186 RERA units, Part 3 & 4 OCCs, Form 4 Architect Certificate) with direct layout CAD OCR model findings on Crown Layout Approval_page_2.
documents_involved: FORM 4 Architect Certificate Wing A and B.pdf
anomalies.significance: Preserved 100% of OCR verbatim strings and layout source citations while maintaining full statutory unit and approval integrity.

something_new.description: Full Occupancy Certificate Granted for Entire 63 Storeys of Wing B: Municipal Corporation of Greater Mumbai granted Part 4 Full Occupation for Wing B under EB/5070/GS/A/OCC/3/New dated 27 September 2024, confirming complete statutory compliance.

Shared Podium Lifestyle Infrastructure (8,931.34 sq.m Total RG): Wing B connects directly to the elevated 10th podium deck featuring Paved RG-1 (8,654.89 sq.m), swimming pool, clubhouse, and fitness centre, shared seamlessly with Wing A.

Multi-Tier Public Parking Lot (PPL) Substructure: Wing B rests upon the integrated 5-tier Public Parking Lot (1st-3rd Basements + Ground + 1st-2nd Podiums) dedicated to municipal parking under Section 33(24) DCPR 2034.
